WITH eligible_trips AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(CAST(t."PULocationID" AS INTEGER), 264) AS pu_location_id,
        COALESCE(z."Borough", 'Unknown') AS borough,
        COALESCE(z."Zone", 'Unknown Zone (' || COALESCE(CAST(t."PULocationID" AS TEXT), 'NULL') || ')') AS pickup_zone,
        COALESCE(z."service_zone", 'N/A') AS service_zone,
        COALESCE(CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER), -1) AS payment_type_id,
        CASE
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 0 THEN 'Flex Fare trip'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Credit card'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 2 THEN 'Cash'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 3 THEN 'No charge'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 4 THEN 'Dispute'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 5 THEN 'Unknown'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 6 THEN 'Voided trip'
                    ELSE 'UNMAPPED_' || COALESCE(CAST(t."payment_type" AS TEXT), 'NULL')
                END AS payment_type_name,
        CAST(t."fare_amount" AS REAL) AS fare_amount,
        (t."extra" + t."mta_tax" + t."improvement_surcharge" + t."congestion_surcharge" + t."airport_fee" + t."cbd_congestion_fee") AS row_surcharges_and_fees,
        COALESCE(CAST(t."tip_amount" AS REAL), 0.0) AS tip_amount,
        COALESCE(CAST(t."tolls_amount" AS REAL), 0.0) AS tolls_amount,
        CAST(t."total_amount" AS REAL) AS total_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN CAST(t."total_amount" AS REAL) > 0.0 AND CAST(t."fare_amount" AS REAL) >= 0.0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_valid_billable_trip
    FROM yellow_tripdata t
    LEFT JOIN taxi_zone_lookup z
        ON COALESCE(CAST(t."PULocationID" AS INTEGER), 264) = CAST(z."LocationID" AS INTEGER)
    WHERE t."tpep_pickup_datetime" >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND t."tpep_pickup_datetime" < '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT
    '2025-01' AS year_month,
    pu_location_id,
    borough,
    pickup_zone,
    service_zone,
    payment_type_id,
    payment_type_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trip_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_trip_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reversal_trip_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN fare_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS fare_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN row_surcharges_and_fees ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 2) AS surcharges_and_fees_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN tip_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS tip_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN tolls_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS tolls_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS gross_passenger_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 0 THEN total_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS reversal_adjustments_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS net_total_amount_usd,
    ROUND(
         COALESCE(
            SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0.0 END)
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
            0.0
        ),
        2
    ) AS avg_revenue_per_trip_usd
FROM eligible_trips
GROUP BY
    pu_location_id,
    borough,
    pickup_zone,
    service_zone,
    payment_type_id,
    payment_type_name
ORDER BY
    gross_passenger_revenue_usd DESC,
    pu_location_id ASC,
    payment_type_id ASC;

Included surcharge columns ['extra', 'mta_tax', 'improvement_surcharge', 'congestion_surcharge', 'airport_fee', 'cbd_congestion_fee'] (row_level_coalesce=True, strict_temporal_filter=True). Segregated negative reversal trips (110 rows) from valid billable trips (54861 rows) to produce gross_passenger_revenue_usd=$2,689,193.04.

applied_fixes: Wrapped all surcharge/fee columns in row-level COALESCE(col, 0.0) to prevent SQL NULL propagation on 2025 Flex Fare trips.

Adapted schema mapping for 5 drift finding(s): active_surcharge_columns=['extra', 'mta_tax', 'improvement_surcharge', 'congestion_surcharge', 'airport_fee', 'cbd_congestion_fee'], payment_types=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].
details.sql_query:
WITH eligible_trips AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(CAST(t."PULocationID" AS INTEGER), 264) AS pu_location_id,
        COALESCE(z."Borough", 'Unknown') AS borough,
        COALESCE(z."Zone", 'Unknown Zone (' || COALESCE(CAST(t."PULocationID" AS TEXT), 'NULL') || ')') AS pickup_zone,
        COALESCE(z."service_zone", 'N/A') AS service_zone,
        COALESCE(CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER), -1) AS payment_type_id,
        CASE
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 0 THEN 'Flex Fare trip'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 'Credit card'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 2 THEN 'Cash'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 3 THEN 'No charge'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 4 THEN 'Dispute'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 5 THEN 'Unknown'
                    WHEN CAST(t."payment_type" AS INTEGER) = 6 THEN 'Voided trip'
                    ELSE 'UNMAPPED_' || COALESCE(CAST(t."payment_type" AS TEXT), 'NULL')
                END AS payment_type_name,
        CAST(t."fare_amount" AS REAL) AS fare_amount,
        (COALESCE(t."extra", 0.0) + COALESCE(t."mta_tax", 0.0) + COALESCE(t."improvement_surcharge", 0.0) + COALESCE(t."congestion_surcharge", 0.0) + COALESCE(t."airport_fee", 0.0) + COALESCE(t."cbd_congestion_fee", 0.0)) AS row_surcharges_and_fees,
        COALESCE(CAST(t."tip_amount" AS REAL), 0.0) AS tip_amount,
        COALESCE(CAST(t."tolls_amount" AS REAL), 0.0) AS tolls_amount,
        CAST(t."total_amount" AS REAL) AS total_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN CAST(t."total_amount" AS REAL) > 0.0 AND CAST(t."fare_amount" AS REAL) >= 0.0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_valid_billable_trip
    FROM yellow_tripdata t
    LEFT JOIN taxi_zone_lookup z
        ON COALESCE(CAST(t."PULocationID" AS INTEGER), 264) = CAST(z."LocationID" AS INTEGER)
    WHERE t."tpep_pickup_datetime" >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND t."tpep_pickup_datetime" < '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT
    '2025-01' AS year_month,
    pu_location_id,
    borough,
    pickup_zone,
    service_zone,
    payment_type_id,
    payment_type_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trip_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_trip_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reversal_trip_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN fare_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS fare_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN row_surcharges_and_fees ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 2) AS surcharges_and_fees_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN tip_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS tip_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN tolls_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS tolls_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS gross_passenger_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 0 THEN total_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS reversal_adjustments_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS net_total_amount_usd,
    ROUND(
         COALESCE(
            SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0.0 END)
            / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_valid_billable_trip = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
            0.0
        ),
        2
    ) AS avg_revenue_per_trip_usd
FROM eligible_trips
GROUP BY
    pu_location_id,
    borough,
    pickup_zone,
    service_zone,
    payment_type_id,
    payment_type_name
ORDER BY
    gross_passenger_revenue_usd DESC,
    pu_location_id ASC,
    payment_type_id ASC;
